legend.title: Legend
legend.barrier: Barrier: circle size grows with severity; the number is the severity
legend.anchor: Landmark: white circle with a dark ring
legend.demoPath: Demo route: wide purple dashed line with a white edge
legend.coverageDetail: Tap a band to see how many images cover it and whether the coverage comes from real images or seeded demo data
legend.imageOwn: Own photo: magenta circle with a dark ring
legend.imageMapillary: Mapillary image: teal circle with a white ring
legend.imageReport: Report photo: brown circle with a white ring
legend.imageArrow: A black arrow beside the circle points where the camera faced; no arrow means the heading is unknown
legend.routeNaive: Naive accessible: medium dotted orange line
legend.routeSamaan: SAMAAN: thick solid purple line with a white edge
legend.routeUnknown: Grey striped overlay: an unchecked stretch of the selected route
legend.routeBarrier: Red ring: a barrier on the selected route; the ring pulses unless reduced motion is on
legend.pendingReport: Pending report: hollow blue circle with a question mark, not yet validated
legend.mission: Mission: thick dashed grey line labelled with the street name

sensors.title: Live sensors
sensors.heading: Heading

geoError.timeout: The location request timed out; still trying.

route.title: Plan a route
route.intro: Compare what a normal map suggests with a route built for you.
route.originSearch: Origin: search a place or street
route.destinationSearch: Destination: search a place or street
route.pickHint: Tap or click the map to set the {{field}}.
route.demoHint: Riya uses a wheelchair. Karkarduma metro to a friend's house, 800 m. See what a normal map misses.

risk.label: Risk tolerance
risk.strictHint: Avoid every unchecked footpath and uncertain barrier, even if the route gets much longer.
risk.balancedHint: Trade a little extra distance for footpaths that have been checked.
risk.relaxedHint: Prefer the shorter route; unchecked footpaths cost only a small penalty.

route.departHint: Only the hour matters: some barriers (parked vehicles, vendors) come and go.
route.compareDisabled: Set both an origin and a destination first.

errors.tooFar: A point is too far from any known footpath (more than 150 m). Pick a point closer to a footpath on the map.
errors.demoUnknown: The demo trip is not available on this API.
errors.badParams: The route request was invalid. Check the profile, risk and time.
errors.generic: Could not get routes. The SAMAAN API is unreachable or returned an error.

route.snapped: {{field}} moved {{m}} m to the nearest footpath.

shortest.title: Shortest
shortest.explain: What a normal map does: fastest for a walker, ignores barriers.

naive_accessible.title: Naive accessible
naive_accessible.explain: Avoids known barriers but treats never-seen footpaths as clear.

samaan.title: SAMAAN
samaan.explain: Applies your profile's rules and penalises unchecked footpaths; honest about what was verified.

route.verifiedBarAlt: Footpath verification: {{verified}} percent checked, {{unknown}} percent never seen, {{blocked}} percent blocked
route.noBarriers: No known barriers on this route.
route.noUnknown: Every footpath on this route has been checked.

user.title: Who are you?
user.intro: Reports and votes carry a display name so the community can build trust. No password needed.
user.name: Display name
user.error: Could not create the user. The SAMAAN API is unreachable or returned an error.
user.needed: Tell us who you are to continue.
user.team: I am on the SAMAAN team
user.teamHint: Team members start trusted, so one vote can verify a report during the demo.

report.title: Report a barrier
report.intro: Take a photo where you stand. Other citizens will validate it; verified reports update the map and routes.
report.introFixed: Confirm this barrier is gone with a photo of the spot. After validation it is removed from the map and routes.
report.gpsNone: No GPS position. Allow location access; the report needs it.
report.noCamera: The live camera is not available here (it needs HTTPS or localhost and camera permission); you can still choose or take a photo below.
report.notePlaceholder: e.g. blocks the whole footpath after 6 pm
report.prescreenNone: Detector did not recognise it; validation needed.
report.duplicate: Looks like known barrier #{{id}}; your report adds evidence to it.

errors.noUser: Tell us who you are first.
errors.noPhoto: A photo is required to report a fix.
errors.noGps: Waiting for a GPS position; try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimit: Too many reports in a short time. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.gpsOffset: Your photo location is more than 50 m from where you are. Walk closer to the barrier and try again.
errors.notFound: That barrier no longer exists on the server.
errors.invalid: The report was rejected as invalid. Check the class, severity and photo.
errors.generic: Could not send the report. The SAMAAN API is unreachable or returned an error.

validate.title: Validate reports
validate.intro: Look at the photo and say whether the report matches what you see. Agreement from several people verifies it and updates the map and routes.
validate.nearby: Showing pending reports within 300 m of you.
validate.fallbackNoGps: Your location is unavailable, so these are the newest pending reports anywhere.
validate.fallbackNone: No pending reports within 300 m, so these are the newest pending reports anywhere.
validate.error: Could not load reports. The SAMAAN API is unreachable or returned an error.
validate.question: Does this match what you see?
validate.keyHint: Keyboard: press 1 to agree, 2 to disagree, 3 for unsure.
validate.resolvedVerified: Verified — the map and routes were updated.
validate.resolvedFixed: Fixed — the barrier was removed from the map and routes.
validate.ownReport: This is your own report; you cannot vote on it.
validate.alreadyResolved: This report was already resolved by others.
validate.voteError: Could not save the vote. The SAMAAN API is unreachable or returned an error.

missions.title: Missions
missions.intro: A mission is a stretch of footpath nobody has photographed yet but many routes need; walking it with the camera fills the biggest gap in the map.
missions.empty: No missions right now. Recompute to look for gaps.
missions.error: Could not load missions. The SAMAAN API is unreachable or returned an error.
missions.recomputeError: Could not recompute missions. The SAMAAN API is unreachable or returned an error.
missions.walkHint: Opens the capture page with session id mission-{{id}}.
